page.overview:
Who is Kanthus?

Kanthus, one of the Argonauts, son of Kanethus and grandson of Abas. He was killed by Kaphaurus (or Kephalion), son of Amphithemis and Tritonis, in Libya Kanthus According to Valerius Flaccus, however, he was killed by Gesander during the Kolkhian war.
